Definition: as far (or long, or much) as, whether of space (even unto) or time (during, while, until) or degree (equally with)
BiblicalUsage: Ad is the word for "until," "as far as" — of space, of time, of degree. "Till thou return unto the ground"; the raven that "went forth to and fro, until the waters were dried up"; the Passover lamb, of which "ye shall let nothing of it remain until the morning." It is one of the commonest small words in the Bible, framing curse, deliverance, and command alike.
TheologicalSignificance: The word for 'until' is one of the commonest small words in the Bible, and it teaches nothing by itself — the curse, the flood, and the Passover do the teaching.
RelatedEvents: The Fall; Noah and the Flood; The Passover
